about: Every key requirements_create.py reads from a requirements specification's data file. The builder stops on a key that is not here, and on a value of another shape (skills/_shared/spec_guard.py). Context and assumptions that are no requirement go in facts, one statement each.

hints.requirements.verification_method: how a requirement is verified is "verification"
hints.requirements.priority: a requirement has no priority field: say it in its "rationale"
hints.requirements.title: a requirement is its id and its text; a heading for a group of them is "section"
